Names such as lazygit, separated by commas. Use * in a path pattern, or * alone for any program. Shell names match only at the prompt.

Only plain : commands get Enter, as in Neovim.

One shortcut per line, optionally named: Name = keys. Write Name := action to run a custom Rex action instead of keys; Rex runs it from the palette and shows any error it reports. [Group] headers put the following shortcuts in a submenu; [] ends the group. Add :blue, :green, :orange or :purple to colour a group, as in [Git:green]. Start a line with ! to ask before sending it. Key notation: <CR>, <Esc>, <Tab>, <Space>, <C-x>, <M-x>, arrows and F1–F12.
